# interfere_public_keys (Data Source)

List active workspace publishable keys without managing them. Reads require org:workspace_auth:read or org:surfaces:read. Public key content is a browser credential, not a secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "interfere_public_keys" "workspace" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
}

output "browser_public_key" {
  value = one([for key in data.interfere_public_keys.workspace.public_keys : key.content if key.name == "Browser"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Read-Only

- `public_keys` (Attributes Set) Active workspace publishable keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--public_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `public_keys`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String) Publishable browser credential. It is not a secret.
- `id` (String) Unique public key identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name of the public key.
